name: codingwithrk/firebase-crashlytics
description: A NativePHP Mobile plugin for Firebase Crashlytics. Records fatal and non-fatal errors, breadcrumb logs, user identifiers and custom keys, and reports them to the Firebase console - modeled after the firebase_crashlytics Flutter package.

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseCrashlytics.RecordError
bridge_functions.description: Records a caught exception/error with Crashlytics

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseCrashlytics.Log
bridge_functions.description: Adds a custom log message to be included in the next crash/error report

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseCrashlytics.SetUserId
bridge_functions.description: Sets a user identifier that will be associated with subsequent crash reports

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseCrashlytics.SetCustomKey
bridge_functions.description: Sets a custom key/value pair that will be associated with subsequent crash reports

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseCrashlytics.Crash
bridge_functions.description: Forces an immediate, unrecoverable native crash for testing your Crashlytics integration

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseCrashlytics.SetCollectionEnabled
bridge_functions.description: Enables or disables automatic crash report collection

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseCrashlytics.IsCollectionEnabled
bridge_functions.description: Returns whether automatic crash report collection is enabled

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseCrashlytics.CheckForUnsentReports
bridge_functions.description: Checks whether there are any unsent crash reports on disk

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseCrashlytics.SendUnsentReports
bridge_functions.description: Uploads any unsent crash reports to Firebase

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseCrashlytics.DeleteUnsentReports
bridge_functions.description: Deletes any unsent crash reports from disk

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseCrashlytics.DidCrashOnPreviousExecution
bridge_functions.description: Returns whether the app crashed during its previous execution
